term: locally essential transmission of causal activity
definition: A node is active if and only if there exists an active node that immediately causes it in the selected dependency relation. The rule itself does not fix a unique global solution or prescribe a response to cutting a link; the ESSENTIAL-POWER-UNDERDETERMINED result separately constructs one admissible downstream-extinguishing response for every cut. This is a local constraint, not automatically an account of the ultimate ground of a power.
note: A deliberately strong local model of instrumental dependence, motivated by the Second Way's removal-of-cause reasoning. The claim that this exhausts real per se causation is not attributed to Aquinas or asserted by the mathematical result.
